```{r}
# Load libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(orchaRd)
library(janitor)
library(here)
library(brms)
```


```{r}
#| label: read-data
#| message: false
#| warning: false

dat_raw <- readr::read_csv(
  here::here("data", "PROCEEDv6.2_RatesDB.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  janitor::clean_names()

glimpse(dat_raw)
```





```{r}
#| label: prep-allochronic-data
#| message: false
#| warning: false

dat_syn <- dat_raw |>
  filter(
    design == "Allochronic",
    !is.na(generations),
    generations <= 300
  ) |>
  filter(
    !is.na(mean1), !is.na(mean2),
    !is.na(sd1), !is.na(sd2),
    !is.na(n1), !is.na(n2),
    !is.na(years), years > 0
  ) |>
  mutate(
    n_total = n1 + n2,
    ref_id = factor(ref_id),
    sys_id = factor(sys_id),
    sp_ncbi = factor(sp_ncbi),
    genphen = factor(genphen),
    disturbance = factor(disturbance),
    trait_type = factor(trait_type),
    log10_years = log10(years)
  ) |>
  droplevels()

dat_syn |>
  summarise(
    k = n(),
    n_studies = n_distinct(ref_id),
    n_systems = n_distinct(sys_id),
    n_species = n_distinct(sp_ncbi),
    min_generations = min(generations, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_generations = max(generations, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_n_total = min(n_total, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_n_total = median(n_total, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```


```{r}
#| label: check-grouping-redundancy
#| message: false
#| warning: false

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Diagnostic for overlap / nesting among grouping variables
# This is more useful than "correlation" for random effects.
#
# IMPORTANT:
# - es_id_db keeps the original PROCEED es_ID
# - later, for brms, you can still create a new sequential es_id
#   for gr(es_id, cov = vcv_syn), but keep es_id_db for diagnostics
# ------------------------------------------------------------

dat_re_diag <- dat_syn |>
  transmute(
    es_id_db = factor(es_id),   # original PROCEED es_ID
    ref_id   = factor(ref_id),
    sys_id   = factor(sys_id),
    sp_ncbi  = factor(sp_ncbi)
  ) |>
  tidyr::drop_na(es_id_db, ref_id, sys_id, sp_ncbi) |>
  droplevels()

# helper: does factor A map uniquely into factor B?
check_nesting <- function(data, a, b) {
  tmp <- data |>
    dplyr::count(.data[[a]], .data[[b]], name = "n") |>
    dplyr::count(.data[[a]], name = "n_unique_b")

  tibble::tibble(
    factor_a = a,
    factor_b = b,
    n_levels_a = dplyr::n_distinct(data[[a]]),
    n_levels_b = dplyr::n_distinct(data[[b]]),
    min_unique_b_per_a    = min(tmp$n_unique_b),
    median_unique_b_per_a = stats::median(tmp$n_unique_b),
    mean_unique_b_per_a   = mean(tmp$n_unique_b),
    max_unique_b_per_a    = max(tmp$n_unique_b),
    prop_a_single_b       = mean(tmp$n_unique_b == 1),
    a_nested_in_b         = all(tmp$n_unique_b == 1)
  )
}

group_vars <- c("es_id_db", "ref_id", "sys_id", "sp_ncbi")

nesting_tbl <- purrr::map_dfr(group_vars, function(a) {
  purrr::map_dfr(setdiff(group_vars, a), function(b) {
    check_nesting(dat_re_diag, a, b)
  })
}) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(a_nested_in_b), factor_a, factor_b)

nesting_tbl

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Quick matrix view: maximum number of B levels within each A
# If max_unique_b_per_a == 1, then A is fully nested in B
# ------------------------------------------------------------

nesting_matrix <- nesting_tbl |>
  dplyr::select(factor_a, factor_b, max_unique_b_per_a) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from  = factor_b,
    values_from = max_unique_b_per_a
  )

nesting_matrix

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Support diagnostics for the hierarchical structure
# These matter for whether a higher-level RE is estimable
# once a lower-level RE is already in the model
# ------------------------------------------------------------

species_support <- dat_re_diag |>
  dplyr::count(sp_ncbi, sys_id, name = "n_rows") |>
  dplyr::count(sp_ncbi, name = "n_sys_per_species") |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_species                    = dplyr::n(),
    prop_species_with_1_system   = mean(n_sys_per_species == 1),
    median_systems_per_species   = stats::median(n_sys_per_species),
    max_systems_per_species      = max(n_sys_per_species)
  )

species_support

ref_support <- dat_re_diag |>
  dplyr::count(ref_id, sys_id, name = "n_rows") |>
  dplyr::count(ref_id, name = "n_sys_per_ref") |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    n_refs                    = dplyr::n(),
    prop_refs_with_1_system   = mean(n_sys_per_ref == 1),
    median_systems_per_ref    = stats::median(n_sys_per_ref),
    max_systems_per_ref       = max(n_sys_per_ref)
  )

ref_support

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Show the problematic exceptions explicitly
# ------------------------------------------------------------

sys_multiple_species <- dat_re_diag |>
  dplyr::count(sys_id, sp_ncbi, name = "n_rows") |>
  dplyr::count(sys_id, name = "n_species_in_sys") |>
  dplyr::filter(n_species_in_sys > 1) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_species_in_sys))

sys_multiple_species

sys_multiple_refs <- dat_re_diag |>
  dplyr::count(sys_id, ref_id, name = "n_rows") |>
  dplyr::count(sys_id, name = "n_refs_in_sys") |>
  dplyr::filter(n_refs_in_sys > 1) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_refs_in_sys))

sys_multiple_refs

species_multiple_refs <- dat_re_diag |>
  dplyr::count(sp_ncbi, ref_id, name = "n_rows") |>
  dplyr::count(sp_ncbi, name = "n_refs_in_species") |>
  dplyr::filter(n_refs_in_species > 1) |>
  dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(n_refs_in_species))

species_multiple_refs
```




```{r}
#| label: safe-lnm-function
#| message: false
#| warning: false

get_lnM_safe <- function(m1, m2, s1, s2, n1, n2,
                         min_kept = 100000,
                         chunk_init = 5000,
                         seed = 123) {

  out <- orchaRd:::.safe_lnM_indep(
    x1bar = m1, x2bar = m2,
    sd1 = s1, sd2 = s2,
    n1 = n1, n2 = n2,
    min_kept = min_kept,
    chunk_init = chunk_init,
    seed = seed
  )

  tibble::tibble(
    yi_lnM_safe = out$lnM_SAFE,
    vi_lnM_safe = out$var_lnM_SAFE,
    draws_kept  = out$kept,
    draws_total = out$total,
    attempts    = out$attempts,
    status      = out$status
  )
}
```




```{r}
#| label: compute-lnm-allochronic
#| message: false
#| warning: false

dat_syn_es <- dat_syn |>
  mutate(
    safe = purrr::pmap(
      list(mean1, mean2, sd1, sd2, n1, n2),
      ~ get_lnM_safe(..1, ..2, ..3, ..4, ..5, ..6,
                     min_kept = 100000,
                     chunk_init = 5000,
                     seed = 123)
    )
  ) |>
  tidyr::unnest(safe) |>
  filter(
    is.finite(yi_lnM_safe),
    is.finite(vi_lnM_safe),
    vi_lnM_safe > 0
  ) |>
  mutate(
    es_id = factor(seq_len(n()))
  )

dat_syn_es |>
  summarise(
    k = n(),
    min_yi = min(yi_lnM_safe, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_yi = max(yi_lnM_safe, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_vi = min(vi_lnM_safe, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_vi = max(vi_lnM_safe, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_failed = sum(status != "ok", na.rm = TRUE)
  )
```


```{r}
#| label: build-vcv-synchronic
#| message: false
#| warning: false

vcv_syn <- diag(dat_syn_es$vi_lnM_safe)
rownames(vcv_syn) <- dat_syn_es$es_id
colnames(vcv_syn) <- dat_syn_es$es_id

dim(vcv_syn)
```
```{r}
#| label: formula-allochronic
#| message: false
#| warning: false

form_syn_ma <- bf(
  yi_lnM_safe ~ 1  +
    (1 | ref_id) +
    (1 | sys_id) +
    (1 | sp_ncbi) +
    (1 | gr(es_id, cov = vcv_syn)),
  sigma ~ 1 
)

```




```{r}
#| label: priors-allochronic
#| message: false
#| warning: false

prior_syn_ma <- default_prior(
  form_syn_ma,
  data = dat_syn_es,
  data2 = list(vcv_syn = vcv_syn),
  family = gaussian()
)

prior_syn_ma$prior[
  prior_syn_ma$class == "sd" &
  prior_syn_ma$group == "es_id"
] <- "constant(1)"

prior_syn_ma
```



```{r}
#| label: fit-brms-allochronic
#| message: false
#| warning: false

fit_syn_ma <- brm(
  formula = form_syn_ma,
  data = dat_syn_es,
  data2 = list(vcv_syn = vcv_syn),
  family = gaussian(),
  prior = prior_syn_ma,
  chains = 2,
  cores = 2,
  iter = 3000,
  warmup = 1500,
  seed = 123,
  backend = "cmdstanr",
  control = list(
    adapt_delta = 0.95,
    max_treedepth = 15
  )
)

summary(fit_syn_ma)
```
